verdict.rationale: RUN documents importing employees' hours from an existing timesheet file into the payroll run, using AI. It also claims payroll can be connected with time-tracking tools. Overtime handling is never mentioned, and the flow shown is a file import rather than a continuous direct sync. Missing for 10: overtime calculation or flow-through, native or real-time time-entry sync into payroll runs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run

citations.quote: Instantly import into RUN your employees’ hours from the timesheet file you already use today, thanks to the power of AI.
Connect payroll with time tracking, benefits, retirement and other business tools when you need them, helping reduce duplicate work
